utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Leo, we're putting together a repair drive this Saturday at Sam's garage. Would you be able to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday works for me. What time should I be at Sam's?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks Leo! Sam said we're starting around 9 AM—and I know the book club's bringing muffins, so we'll be well-fueled.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So what exactly are we collecting for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We're collecting broken tools and appliances from neighbors to fix them up and share.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So who's already donated something? I want to know what we're working with.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect timing, Nell! I've got you down for the porch step, and we're just about to kick things off after we finish up with the tools here.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's wonderful, Mara! I'll be ready whenever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, let me just grab the toolbox and I'll head over to your porch shortly.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Quinn, we're set for Saturday morning. Opal's got a list, and I'll bring my toolbox. Coffee and donuts sounds great.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Eli, I've got the tool inventory ready, and I've confirmed with everyone—Saturday at 10 AM sharp at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, Opal. I'll be there with my toolbox at 10 sharp. Thanks for organizing everything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Rosa, sorry I'm late—what did I miss about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's next Saturday at the community center. I think there's still room on the sign-up sheet if you need to bring something in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh great, thanks Rey—I'll check the sheet and grab a spot. What's still needed?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the community garden shed at 9 AM—can I count on you to help out?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? Oh yes, I think I have a wrench somewhere... or was that for the garden shed? What time did you say again?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: 9 AM sharp, Oren! And bring that wrench — we'll have you on tool duty if you're game.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, Ira—before we go further, which repair drive are you talking about? I want to make sure I'm on the right page.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: The one for the community center—it got moved to Sunday, and Leo’s got tools ready for 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, thanks for clarifying! So it's the community center drive on Sunday at 9 AM. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Sam, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up old electronics and appliances at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Tess! I'll be there with my toolbox and a few extension cords. Need me to bring anything specific for the electronics station?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's perfect, Sam! We could definitely use extension cords. And if you have any old power strips lying around, bring those too—we're setting up a whole testing bench.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I do hope folks remember their sign-ups; we've got the school runs to work around, and without that list, it's going to be a juggling act.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help you track down anyone who missed the sign-up, Pia. Just give me the names.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that would be a huge help, Uli—let me grab the list so you can see who's still outstanding.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks for having my back, Kira. Let's just roll with it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on, Bo, roll with what exactly? I still haven't seen any solid proof this drive is even needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Honestly, I just skimmed something about it, so I'm not sure. But we're probably fine.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Faye, did you hear we're planning a neighborhood repair drive next Saturday? I'm going to help folks fix up their fences and stuff.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Vik! I can help coordinate the timing around school pickup schedules if that's useful.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That would be awesome, Faye! So I'll tell everyone you're helping with the schedule for the repair drive next Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Noah, you coming to the repair drive Saturday? Got plenty of tools to share.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday? I thought it was tomorrow... or was that the garden shed thing? I'll be there, just might show up on the wrong day.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Easy mix-up, Noah — the garden shed thing is Sunday. Saturday's the repair drive at the community center, 10 AM sharp.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Cleo, could you help me double-check the tool inventory before Saturday's repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing, Mara! I've been meaning to do a count ever since Opal asked me to help. Got my clipboard right here.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Cleo! Let's start with the power tools—I want to make sure we have enough working drills for the porch step repairs Nell mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Vik, I keep hearing about this repair drive—any chance you know if there's still space on the sign-up sheet for my porch step?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: The repair drive is this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center—we're fixing up the garden shed, but I'm sure they can squeeze in your porch step too!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's a relief! I'll be sure to bring my step over Saturday morning—thanks for the heads-up, Vik!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I think I heard about that. When is it again?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Uh, I'm not really sure on the timing—I just skimmed something about it. I think we're good on supplies though.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, supplies! Did anyone bring a toaster? I think I had one... maybe it's in my garage.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Just a heads up, Eli's confirmed he's bringing his screwdriver and thermos. We're all set for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That's right, Jules. I've got my tools ready and my coffee will be hot. Saturday mornings are the best for getting things done.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Eli! I'll make sure there's a spot for you near the main workbench.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Well, I'm glad Ira confirmed the tools, but I'm still nervous about people just wandering in without a slot—hope Faye's schedule keeps things orderly.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help check people in at the door if you want—that way we can keep things running smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that would be a huge help, Rey—thank you! If you can keep a list and wave people in one at a time, that'll keep the chaos down.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Faye! I'm so glad you're here—have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up old electronics and appliances at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I'm helping coordinate around school pickup times—happy to chip in however I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's wonderful, Faye! I knew I could count on you. Could you maybe spread the word to the other parents at pickup?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure this repair drive is actually needed? I haven't noticed any problems myself.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Kira, I know it might not be obvious, but lots of neighbors have mentioned small fixes—like the broken bench at the park or Mrs. Chen's wobbly fence. It's about keeping our community in good shape together.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: But have you actually seen the bench broken yourself, or is it just hearsay?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Opal, did you hear the repair drive got moved to Sunday? Just making sure everyone knows.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, says who? I got it set for Saturday at 10 at the community center. Let me check my notes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, Rosa told me just now—something about a scheduling conflict. Sunday at the same time and place.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I've got tools ready, Dane. Should we start with the fence gates Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds like a plan! I can grab the toolbox I borrowed from Eli.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Great, I'll meet you at the community center at 9.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sorry Leo, are you talking about the community center's computers or the general neighborhood repair drive this weekend? I want to make sure we're on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The driveway needs patching, not computers. Tomorrow morning works for me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, driveway patching? I think we're mixing up two different things—I've been asking about the community center's electronics repair, not any driveway work.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So you're handling both the playground bench and a repair drive? That's a lot on your plate. How's Cleo's car doing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, Cleo's car is running smooth now—just needed a quick fix. And no worries, I've got the bench and the drive under control.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Glad to hear Cleo's car is fixed. So what exactly are we collecting for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Sam, thanks for offering! Some extra screwdrivers and a level would be perfect. You're coming Saturday at 9, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I'll grab them from the garage tonight and see you at 9 AM on Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, see you then! I'll also round up a few more neighbors to join us.
